verdict.summary: shippingservice was redeployed at 12:16 with an image reference pointing at a different service's artifact (an adservice build), so its GetQuote RPC no longer exists and every checkout shipping-quote call fails.
verdict.reasoning: checkoutservice alerted first but its traces show the error originating at the checkout->shipping GetQuote hop, with no healthy server-side shipping span and all sibling dependency calls (cart, currency, productcatalog) fast and clean; errors therefore propagate upward from shipping into checkout and frontend/loadgenerator. The change record for shippingservice shows an image reference switched at 12:16 to an artifact belonging to a different component and not reverted, which matches the second error-ratio change point at 12:17 and the onset at 12:19. shippingservice logs flip at 12:16 from normal quote handling to a rejection of GetQuote by the running build, and runtime startup banners repeat from 12:16 onward, consistent with a newly rolled, wrong artifact. The earlier 11:59-12:05 spike had a different mechanism (a quote backend address pointing at a nonexistent host) but that env change was reverted at 12:05, so the sustained incident is the image, not that config.
open_questions: Whether the 12:16 image change was also reverted after the observation window closed
Whether the repeated runtime startups indicate crash-looping pods or merely rollout churn
Whether the earlier 11:59-12:05 config episode contributed to the first change point at 12:00 independently of the image change
